summary: Enveric Biosciences filed an 8-K to correct a typographical error in its definitive proxy statement (Schedule 14A) regarding the reverse stock split ratio range. The error appeared in the proxy statement, proxy card, and Notice of Internet Availability, incorrectly stating the range. The filing solely addresses a clerical fix to the disclosure for the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, with no economic terms, board recommendation changes, or structural mechanics beyond the correction. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring involved.
